reason: Both conversations correctly explain the flame failure device and escalate to a Gas Safe registered engineer, and both miss the key safety question about gas smell with the cooker off and never ask for the model number. Conversation 1 edges ahead because it engaged across two turns, offered only safe, within-boundary self-help (checking seating, cleaning visible burnt-on fat with the cooker cool and off - which matches the likely cause of flame not reaching the probe) and still insisted on an engineer for any thermocouple or valve work. Conversation 2 is sound and concise but offers no safe first steps, dismisses cleaning somewhat prematurely with an 'almost certainly' thermocouple diagnosis, and gathers no information; Conversation 1's 'burner cap' wording is slightly misapplied to an oven burner, which keeps the margin slight.
